typicalChallenges: How will you patch and update the compute platform without service disruption?
What is the attack surface of the chosen compute model and how is it minimised?
How are container images or VM images scanned for vulnerabilities before deployment?
What isolation exists between workloads if sharing compute infrastructure?
What skills does the team need to operate this compute platform and do they currently have them?
How will you monitor resource utilisation and respond to capacity issues?
What is the operational overhead of the chosen platform compared to managed alternatives?
How will you handle compute platform upgrades and end-of-life transitions?
How long will it take the team to become productive on this compute platform?
Does the chosen platform support the deployment frequency the team needs?
Are there sufficient development and testing environments available?
What is the lead time for provisioning new compute resources?
What is the monthly running cost and how does it scale with usage?
Have you considered reserved capacity or savings plans for the baseline workload?
How does the cost compare to the current on-premises hosting arrangement?
What happens to costs if usage grows 2x or 5x beyond current projections?
